classification.difficultyReason: Interpret whole and half shaded cells using equal area units, then convert each shaded fraction into a percentage and decimal.

content.prompt: Write the shaded parts as a fraction, percentage, and decimal of the whole.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2a model above the response table
spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with two rows and ten columns; the first three cells of the top row are shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied shaded model is visible; numerical responses are controlled separately.

answer.worked:
There are 3 shaded cells out of 20 equal cells.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Fraction}&=\frac{3}{20}\\\text{Percentage}&=\frac{3}{20}\times100\%\\&=15\%\\\text{Decimal}&=3\div20\\&=0.15\end{align*}$$

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2b model above the response table
spec.description: Five-by-five square grid with the upper three rows shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied shaded model is visible; numerical responses are controlled separately.

answer.worked:
There are 15 shaded cells out of 25 equal cells.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Fraction}&=\frac{15}{25}\\&=\frac35\\\text{Percentage}&=\frac{15}{25}\times100\%\\&=60\%\\\text{Decimal}&=15\div25\\&=0.6\end{align*}$$

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2c model above the response table
spec.description: Horizontal strip of five square cells. The first cell and the lower-left triangular half of the second cell are shaded.
spec.mathematics: One and a half of five equal cells are shaded, equivalent to 3 of 10 equal half-cells.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied shaded model is visible; numerical responses are controlled separately.

answer.worked:
The shaded area is one whole cell and half a cell. Counting in half-cells gives 3 shaded halves out of 10 equal halves.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Fraction}&=\frac{3}{10}\\\text{Percentage}&=\frac{3}{10}\times100\%\\&=30\%\\\text{Decimal}&=3\div10\\&=0.3\end{align*}$$

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2d model above the response table
spec.description: Two-by-five rectangle. Both cells in the first column and the lower-left triangular half of the second bottom-row cell are shaded.
spec.mathematics: Two and a half of ten equal cells are shaded, equivalent to 5 of 20 equal half-cells or one quarter of the whole.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied shaded model is visible; numerical responses are controlled separately.

answer.worked:
The shaded area is two whole cells and half a cell. Counting in half-cells gives 5 shaded halves out of 20 equal halves.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Fraction}&=\frac{5}{20}\\&=\frac14\\\text{Percentage}&=\frac14\times100\%\\&=25\%\\\text{Decimal}&=1\div4\\&=0.25\end{align*}$$
